integrity: The first example predates the source paper, and both primitive cycles were published previously; new contribution is the unrestricted proof of completeness at period six. The exact finite support certificate and standalone verifier accompany the mathematical proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only positive integer five-free Fibonacci cycles whose period divides six are classified. The existence of longer cycles and the fate of arbitrary initial pairs are not determined.
title: The two primitive six-cycles of five-free Fibonacci dynamics
